plan.name: Example Company CommonCare Welfare Benefit Plan

defaultClass.description: All common-law employees regularly scheduled to work at least 30 hours per week

defaultWaitingPeriod.description: Coverage begins on the first day of the month following 30 days of employment

eligibility.enrollmentProcedure: Enroll through the Employer's benefits enrollment system during the stated initial or annual enrollment period.
eligibility.coverageTermination: Coverage ordinarily ends on the last day of the month in which eligibility ends, subject to the applicable Benefit Appendix and continuation rights.
eligibility.rehireRule: An Employee rehired within 30 days resumes the elections in effect immediately before termination when the applicable coverage can be reinstated; a later rehire is administered as a new eligibility event unless law or a Benefit Appendix requires otherwise.
eligibility.leaveRule: Coverage and contribution collection during an approved leave are administered under the Employer's leave procedures and applicable FMLA and USERRA restoration requirements.

cafeteriaPlan.electionPeriod: The Plan Year, with initial and annual elections made before coverage begins.
cafeteriaPlan.midyearElectionProcedure: Request a permitted prospective election change through the Employer's benefits enrollment system within the period stated in the cafeteria plan.

enrollmentSchedule.name: Example Company Benefits Enrollment Schedule
enrollmentSchedule.description: The enrollment schedule applicable to the Participant's eligible class, coverage period, age, location, and elected coverage.
enrollmentSchedule.deliveryMethod: Available in the Employer's benefits enrollment system and provided with the applicable enrollment materials.

benefits.name: Self-Funded Basic MEC
benefits.participantSummary: Employee-only preventive coverage delivered through approved providers; it is not comprehensive major medical coverage.
benefits.fundingDescription: Self-funded by the Employer and paid from its general assets.

spd.audience: Employees and other persons eligible for benefits under the Plan
spd.howToUse: Read the common information in this SPD together with the benefit section for each coverage in which you enroll.

alternativeCompanion.employerSponsoredPlanDescription: The benefits listed in Appendix B of the CommonCare Welfare Benefit Plan
alternativeCompanion.acknowledgmentDeadline: Before the first payroll deduction or direct payment

choiceIchra.eligibleClass: All full-time salaried Employees in the adopted ICHRA class
choiceIchra.contributionVariation: Amount varies only by participant age and family size under the adopted contribution schedule
choiceIchra.permittedExpenses: Individual health insurance premiums and other Code section 213(d) medical expenses

commonFunded.allocationObjective: Coordinate lower-premium major medical coverage with CommonFunds amounts available for eligible Participant expenses.
commonFunded.bandingDescription: Allowance amounts may be adjusted by Participant age and applicable insurance rating area as shown in the Enrollment Schedule and permitted by the underlying coverage rules.

allocation.priorityRule: Allocate genuinely Employer-only amounts to the EBHRA up to its limit, then allocate valid Employer Health FSA funding; treat cashable amounts elected into the Health FSA as salary reduction.

hra.eligibleExpenses: Eligible Code section 213(d) medical expenses other than premiums prohibited for an EBHRA
hra.carryoverRule: No carryover is adopted; unused amounts remain Employer property after the applicable claims period.

healthFsa.eligibleExpenses: Eligible Code section 213(d) medical expenses permitted by the adopted Health FSA schedule
healthFsa.unusedAmountRule: After the claims runout, unused amounts are forfeited and remain or revert to the Employer or Plan, subject to applicable law.

endingBalance.defaultRule: No component carries over by default. After timely claims are paid, unused amounts remain or revert to the Employer or Plan, subject to applicable law.

ptcPlan.employerSponsoredBenefits: Dental, vision, and separately adopted excepted benefits
ptcPlan.acknowledgmentDeadline: Before the Marketplace coverage effective date
